An interactive crossword on oceans rebuilt here with a custom made R package [`crosswordwidget`](https://github.com/ankurjamwal/crosswordwidget). Click a cell, type an answer, use the arrow keys to move around, and use Check or Reveal when you're ready. Happy crosswording!

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
devtools::load_all("C:/R projects/crosswordwidget")

clues <- data.frame(
  answer = c(
    "MARIANA", "CORAL", "CHALLENGER", "PNEUMATOPHORE", "TIDE", "ZOOXANTHELLAE", "AGAR", "ARAL", "UNCLOS", "KNOT", "BAY", "COAST"
    
  ),
  clue = c(
    "From Roman God of war and will require to dive very deep",
    "Jellyfish cousin but tougher and immobile. Do not be fooled by its pretty colours, it stings",
    "A test and a quest of the heavens and the deep",
    "I gasp for breath in a marsh sweet and salt. Find me, I am rooting for you",
    "I rise to the moon, like a werevolf. Sailors fear my temper not my fangs",
    "Name translates to 'little yellow animal' but is a plant", "Out of the red (algae), to thicken a bacterial bed",
    "Once the fourth largest lake, but now almost gone",
    "Laws of the Sea",
    "I am tied to the oceans but I never drown",
    "I am a peninsula of water, not land. If you don't know me yet, keep me at a distance",
    "I have no feet, yet I walk beside the sea"
    
  )
)

crossword(clues)
```
